title: Request a food safety supervisor certificate
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a replacement food safety supervisor certificate if your original certificate is lost or damaged.
intro:
If your food safety supervisor certificate has been lost or damaged, contact the registered training organisation (RTO) that issued the certificate for a replacement.

If the RTO is no longer operating or has let its NSW Food Authority approval lapse, you can lodge an application with the Food Authority. They will be able to reissue a replacement certificate.
who_can_apply: Must have completed all required units as indicated on the form
Must have a qualification from a registered training organisation (RTO) in Australia
Training must have been completed within 5 years from the date of request
what_you_need: A certified copy of your certificate and transcript, or certified copies of your statement/s of attainment
The PDF form: 'FSS certificate request form'

how_to_steps.text: Submit your application by mail, with payment, to the details on the form.

more_info.text: Your FSS certificate is valid for 5 years from the date of issue, after that it will need to be renewed
If your FSS certificate has expired or is about to expire, you need to recertify with an approved RTO. You will have 90 days to replace the expired certificate.

faqs.q: Who should I contact if my food safety supervisor certificate is lost or damaged?
faqs.a: Contact the registered training organisation (RTO) that issued the certificate for a replacement.

faqs.q: What if my original RTO is no longer operating or has lapsed approval?
faqs.a: You can lodge an application with the Food Authority, who will be able to reissue a replacement certificate.

faqs.q: What are the eligibility requirements for applying for a replacement certificate?
faqs.a: You must have completed all required units as indicated on the form, hold a qualification from a registered training organisation (RTO) in Australia, and have completed the training within the last 5 years.
